answer.summary: Changing dynamic.ResourceInterface.List() from returning (*unstructured.UnstructuredList, error) to (PaginatedList, error) would break files in three categories: (1) Files that directly call .List() and use the *UnstructuredList return type (accessing .Items, .UnstructuredContent(), .GetContinue()) — these are the primary breaks. (2) Files that implement/mock the dynamic.ResourceInterface interface with the List() method signature — these fail at compile time. (3) Files that declare or pass dynamic.ResourceInterface values where .List() is called downstream. Across the three repos: Helm has ~6 affected files (centered on lookup_func.go), ArgoCD has ~6 affected files (centered on backup.go and the gitops-engine cache), and Grafana has ~20 affected files (centered on the provisioning resources package, authz folder store, test utilities, and cleanup service).
